title: DRIFTING AWAY FROM THE SAVIOUR
author: Fanny J. Crosby, Ira Allan Sankey
stanzas: Drifting away from the savior, casting reproach on the Lord; Drifting away from His temple, heeding no longer His word.
Drifting away from the savior, slightness and grieving His love, drifting away from from the mansions he is preparing from above
Drifting away... Drifting away... drifting away from the saviour, drifting, still drifting away
Drifting away from the saviour, lonely and helpless thou art; Drifting away from His people, ever so dear to His heart
Drifting away from the saviour, He who has showed the way; Drifting away from His teaching, farther and farther each day
Drifting away from the saviour, Still He is mindful of thee; come unto Him and believing, pardon'd through grace thou shalt be.
